q: Plan limit cross hone par naye donation ko accept karega ya donor ko error dikhega?

Growth mein 5,000 receipts included hain: 10,500 − 5,000 = 5,500 extra × ₹0.70 = ₹3,850 + 18% GST = ₹4,543. Advanced mein 15,000 receipts included hain, isliye 10,500 par koi receipt overage nahi lagega. Starter mein 1,000 included hain aur extra rate ₹0.90 per receipt hai.

Usage charge plan threshold cross hone par auto-settle hota hai: Starter ₹500, Growth ₹1,500, Advanced ₹5,000. Donation kabhi block nahi hoti; receipt issue hoti rahegi. Aap kis plan par hain—Starter, Growth ya Advanced?
